# libxaac decoder provenance

The `common/` and `decoder/` directories were imported from Android's
`platform/external/libxaac` repository at commit
`632e575ee645919c2eba81a7de114cfca66a4087`.

Upstream: <https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/libxaac/>

Only the decoder implementation and its shared sources are included. See
`LICENSE` and `NOTICE` in this directory for the upstream Apache-2.0 terms and
attributions.
